text:
anya: Quick sync — I'm proposing we tighten the onboard pipeline: smoke = deterministic quick checks (<=4m), prober = deeper, reproducible runs (<=2h) that emit signed artifacts. Goal: reduce noisy accepts and speed triage.

lucca: +1. Can we agree on what the prober must publish? I want reproducible artifacts for debugging.

anya: Minimal artifact set: manifest.json (model_digest, tokenizer_digest, handshake_schema, bench_suite_version, seed), metrics.json (p50/p95, cost_est, quality_scores), samples/ (failing input->output pairs), and signature.sig. Store s3://onboard-artifacts/<model>/runs/<id> and keep retention policies.

sam: signature is critical. ops: which key do we use for signing?

ops-bot: INFO: onboarding service KMS key = projects/redwood/keys/onboard-ingest. Use ops verify-signature for checks.

lucca: For sampling, hybrid approach: deterministic core (N=50) + seeded fuzz (N=30 per bucket), plus adversarial known-fail cases. That gives reproducible root-cause plus edge discovery.

anya: Prober must record random_seed, bench_config_hash, runner_image, and commit SHA of bench-suite in manifest so runs are replayable.

sam: Let's standardize failure codes: VOCAB_MISMATCH, TOKENIZATION_DRIFT, KV_SHAPE_MISMATCH, LATENCY_P95_EXCEEDED, QUALITY_REGRESSION, RESOURCE_OOM. Each maps to remediation guidance.

lucca: UX: intake returns compact decision + artifact link even after smoke pass. e.g. {decision: "smoke:pass,prober:queued", artifact: "s3://.../manifest.json"}. Product can fetch detail later.

anya: Important: smoke must be idempotent/read-only. It should not finalize registration; instead it writes provisional status: ingested_provisional. Prober completion or operator override finalizes.

bench-bot: AUTO: scheduled prober run for model 'orca-lite' (mid: m-892) run-id=run-20260321-001. ETA ~70m. artifact path: s3://onboard-artifacts/m-892/runs/run-20260321-001/.

lucca: Tokenization-drift metric: compute exact token-id diffs for core set and report token_match_rate + first_last_token_mismatch_count. If match_rate < threshold -> fail. Explainable.

sam: Quantization note: some quant profiles reorder tail tokens. Add tail_consistency_score (compare last 12 tokens) to metrics.json. If <0.7 -> flag QUALITY_REGRESSION.

ops-bot: POLICY: onboarding artifact retention = 90d by default. Use retain=true for long-term audit.

lucca: Prober orchestration: sandbox job, resource caps, retries backoff 30s->2m->8m up to 3 attempts. If repeated OOM, mark RESOURCE_OOM and attach runner logs.

anya: CLI for local dev:```bash
redwood-ingest --model-dir ./out --run-smoke --output-artifact ./out/smoke-artifact
# emits smoke-manifest.json with minimal fields and exits 0/1
```

sam: Orchestration API example response: {"ingest_id":"m-892","status":{"smoke":"pass","prober":"queued"},"artifact":"s3://.../runs/run-20260321-001/manifest.json"}

lucca: Bench-suite should emit an explainability block per failing sample: tokenized diff, logits-checksum, input snippet. That speeds root cause.

anya: We'll add a tiny remediation table in the API for each error code, e.g., VOCAB_MISMATCH -> "update adapter vocab or provide mapping"; KV_SHAPE_MISMATCH -> "verify kv dims and batch padding".

bench-bot: NOTE: prober started (run-20260321-001). Will post compact metrics+artifact link when complete.

ops-bot: REMINDER: security review required if adapter_metadata.schema_version != handshake_v1. Ops will block auto-finalize until sign-off.

anya: Next steps: I will draft manifest v1 schema + signing shim PR. Lucca -> prober sampling harness. Sam -> remediation doc. Target EOD Thu for PRs. If prober posts a fail, open per-model triage thread and include artifact link. :thumbsup:
